_status: APPROVED by the operator on 2026-09-19 (tracker/LESSONS.md, DECISIONS for Phase 4), written at unit 4.1. Replaces the provisional mandate of 3.4. treasurer/mandate.py refuses to load a mandate with a null or placeholder required field, and the gates refuse every order once it expires or is revoked. cumulative_budget_usd is the live leg's. It was null until Phase 5, which blocked every live order; version 3 sets it to one dollar (the note below).
_execution_wallet_note: Named explicitly here, per planning/PLAN.md section 6 (decision before unit 1.1). Balances are read for this address over RPC, never from /wallet/portfolio, which omits every token (findings F0.7b.8). It is the one wallet all three Bankr keys resolve to (F0.2.3). On 4663 it carries an EIP-7702 delegation to a Bankr contract since its first swap (F0.10.3), so nothing may assume it is an EOA there. On Base it is an EOA.
_execution_wallet_delegate_note: The contract the wallet's EIP-7702 designator names on 4663: its code there reads 0xef0100 followed by this address, measured at 0.10 (findings F0.10.3). The address selftest (1.10) attests it, so a changed delegation turns it red rather than going unnoticed. What the delegate permits is not measured.
_cumulative_budget_note: The ceiling on everything the live leg may ever trade: each live fill at its cash leg plus the gas the real book paid (core/ledger.py traded_usd), checked by gates.live_budget before each live order. Set to one dollar at unit 5.1 (2026-09-19), the operator having authorized the minimum that proves the path; 5.2's round trip is about $0.21 of it. Null blocked every live order until now, which is what it was for.
_allowed_assets_note: The operator's approval (2026-09-19): the 35 markable stocks, each with a Chainlink feed, plus USDG, the cash leg, and ETH, the live leg's asset. Drawn from config/registry/feed_map.json, which lists exactly these 37. Identity is the address; the symbol is display only. The snapshot still decides which are tradeable each cycle. Every leg an order trades must be here (S10), except a held stock being sold (S8).
_approval_note: approved_at is when the approved values were written at 4.1, on the operator's instruction of 2026-09-19; expires_at is 7 days later, as the operator set. A mandate is in force until it expires or is revoked.
